title: Setting Up Your Bitcoin Mining Goals for 2027
hook: New year, new goal: understand mining before you spend on it.

scenes.narration: Know what a block, hashrate and difficulty are before anything else.
Electricity is typically a miner's largest ongoing cost, so efficiency matters.
Rewards vary with price and difficulty, and returns are never promised.

cta: What is your mining goal? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Three goals for 2027: learn the basics, know your costs, expect variance.
